shared.paired_reset: Environment seed, sampling seed, task, objects, and initial poses are identical inside each left/right pair.

models.selection_basis: Exact settings used by the completed standardized pilot; no post-result parameter change.

Pre-v2 local gate: CFG 2.0 produced the only clean prompt-only counterfactual and the strongest prompt-to-sampling action ratio among the tested non-extreme settings. This prior result is disclosed, not re-tuned on v2 scenes.
Released/default action guidance. The pre-v2 action-guidance-3 experiment increased open-loop prompt delta without improving counterfactual completion, so it is not selected.

claim_limit: Efficient-WAM-RT settings are an exact retrospective record because its standardized pilot preceded this registry. FastWAM and LingBot-VA settings are prospectively frozen for their v2 pilots.
